test_item:
The trusted root and intermediate certificates shall be stored in a persistent, read-only partition that is isolated from user operations.
(trusted certificate chain is present at the deployed store path)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Test runner CertProviderAndroidInstrumentalTest.apk is installed
3. The test runner is verified with adb shell pm list instrumentation | grep melcocertprovider (if missing run adb install -r -t CertProviderServiceManagerTest.apk)
4. Certificate assets are available under SecurityAssets/oem-certs/cert-provider/
proc:
1. List the pre-installed CertStore directory structure and DCL file on the device
$ adb shell ls -la /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store/
2. List the configuration files and certificate sub-folders
$ adb shell ls -la /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store/cfgs/
$ adb shell ls -la /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store/oem_cert_tree/
$ adb shell ls -la /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store/ecu_chain/
3. Confirm the content of /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store
er:
1. The adb shell ls -la /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store/ output lists "cfgs/", "oem_cert_tree/", "ecu_chain/" and "dcl.json"
2. The adb shell ls -la /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store/cfgs/ output lists "2nd_party.cfg", "sam.cfg" and "ecu.cfg"
3. The adb shell ls -l /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store output lists the trusted certificate chain files
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
